payload.name: FSS-Net carotid artery segmentation
payload.fact: The FSS-Net model achieves a Dice score of 96.46% for carotid artery segmentation in ultrasound imaging.

provenance.title: FSS-Net: frequency-spatial synergy network with wavelet attention for carotid artery ultrasound segmentation
provenance.quote_or_locus: Extensive experiments on carotid ultrasound datasets show that FSS-Net achieves a Dice score (DSC) of 96.46% and strong robustness under low SNR conditions
